title: cleyera vaccinioides
intro: Cleyera vaccinioides, commonly known as the Japanese Cleyera or Japanese Pagoda Tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Theaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine, particularly in East Asia, due to its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cleyera vaccinioides include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which contribute to its healing effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, triterpenoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
